key_insight: LEAP is a novel framework that leverages a specialized LLM and active learning to efficiently identify perovskite precursor additives.
engineering_relevance: This research improves the performance of perovskite solar cells, which are crucial for sustainable energy technologies.
method: Integration of a domain-specialized LLM for knowledge extraction from literature.
Utilization of Bayesian optimization for uncertainty-aware prioritization of additives.
Incorporation of expert review in the additive screening process.
evidence_signal: LEAP demonstrated improved average device PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% compared to a control PCE of 19.25%.
watch_item: Future scalability of the framework may be limited by the availability of mechanistic insights in the literature.
paper_title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
